content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR NBPGR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR NBPGR Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICAR NBPGR Young Professional recruitment is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: For Young Professional-II, a Master's degree in Agriculture with at least 60% marks is required. For Young Professional-I, a Graduate degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, or Forestry is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Young Professional roles?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening of applications, followed by an online interview, and finally, document verification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Young Professional-II is Rs. 42,000/- per month, and for Young Professional-I, it is Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for the ICAR NBPGR recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete application with all necessary documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any desirable qualifications for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: Yes, for Young Professional-II, experience in field crop phenotyping is desirable. For Young Professional-I, experience in field research and basic computer knowledge is desirable.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ICAR NBPGR located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for positions in Akola, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The positions are contractual in nature.
